highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.152.0 adds Graphite GPU backend bindings and upgrades to Skia milestone m152.
highlights_body: It also adds async pixel readback, a Vulkan Silk.NET package with expanded Vulkan test coverage, and several memory-leak and performance fixes across pixmaps, images and text.

bullets.detail: Bundles the Chrome m152 engine, plus upstream m151 stability fixes merged in along the way.
Adds bindings for Skia's Graphite GPU backend across Vulkan, Metal and Dawn, letting consumers opt into the newer rendering pipeline.
Adds a backend-neutral async RequestReadPixels API to SKImage and SKSurface for non-blocking pixel reads.
Ships a new SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET package and runs Vulkan tests on Android and Linux.
Uses FreeType to provide font support on Nano Server, where the platform font APIs are unavailable.
SKRegion.SpanIterator now roots its owning SKRegion, and SKPixmap.ExtractSubset/With* root their pixel source, closing two native use-after-free paths.
SKImage.Create no longer leaks its native pixel buffer when raster creation fails.
Caches the HandleDictionary skip-registration check, avoids a double buffer copy in SKData.SaveTo, and pre-sizes the SKRuntimeEffect uniform lookup map, reducing overhead on hot paths.

bullets.lead: Fewer allocations in text and encoding paths
bullets.detail: Avoids an intermediate string allocation in the null-terminated GetEncodedText path.
Initializes the MSVC environment once per native build and stops pinning a specific Windows SDK version by default.
Makes binding generation deterministic across platforms and converts all .sln solutions to the newer .slnx format.
Adds Azure Linux, Alpine/musl and Nano Server test containers to widen platform coverage.

contributor_summaries.jeffska: Contributed to the Nano Server FreeType font support work.
contributor_summaries.mmitche: Initialized the MSVC environment once per native build on Windows.

harfbuzz_summary: Refreshes the bundled HarfBuzz binding alongside routine maintenance PRs, with no consumer-facing API changes in this release.
